$comment: MF-42 (FE-31; plan.min cut 5, P42-D9 a): the one data home of the binding boundary. libraries = the MaxBLD-new UI packages (one tier); they may be imported only by a listed binding module, a listed provider, a test file or the vendor dir. A converted surface's mount file (mounts[]) may import only a framework package (framework[]), a binding module or a project-internal path (mount_internal[], relative paths included), never a UI library or any other package. modules[] are exact .tsx files under the R-13 component roots, each owned by a promoted platform_shared census entry (promoted_entries[]). ref_kinds and non_display_keys judge golden props (SV-SBIND); widget_types judges render.form (SV-DESC). Shape: screen-data.schema.json#/definitions/bindings. Read by scripts/surfaces/screen-checks.mjs and the FE-31 and FE-05 locks. Dated note 2026-11-09 (MF-37; D-23, ~/Buildo-scratch/DECISIONS-PREAPPROVED-20261108.md): mapping.web is the closed list of JSX element names each web binding module may render per archetype (FE-31 C-8); RJSF's Mantine theme renders FileInput, NumberInput, TextInput, Select and the submit Button itself, so those names document what a FORM shows rather than JSX in our modules. touch_targets.web lists the Mantine size values that reach 44 px (FE-31 C-9), measured from @mantine/core 9.8.0: inputs and Button lg 50 px, xl 60 px; CloseButton and ActionIcon lg 34 px, xl 44 px. ref_kinds gains contract (FE-32): a golden value {"contract": "<contract_id>.<field>"} names a field of a CONTRACT descriptor's inputs.field_whitelist.
